Method of Attack: Denial of service via infinite loop triggered by parsing maliciously crafted OpenSSL certificate
Integer overflow and invalid shift vulnerabilities in libexpat leading to resource consumption, elevation of privileges, and remote code execution
Attack Vector: Parsing of maliciously crafted OpenSSL certificates
Exploitation of integer overflow and invalid shift bugs in libexpat
Indicators of Compromise: Use of vulnerable Teradici PCoIP client and agents prior to version 22.01.3
